newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to sell North Cyprus 65,000 T feed barley.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to sell North Cyprus 65,000 T feed barley.

text.p: Turkey will sell the breakaway Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (TRNC) 65,000 tonnes of feed barley to help the drought-hit island, officials said on Wednesday.

"This is a new agreement between TRNC and Turkey," said an agricultural official, adding the barley would be supplied by the state Turkish Grain Board (TMO), which is estimated to hold about 200,000 tonnes of barley in emergency stocks from 1996/97.
The agreement was reached between the Turkish agriculture ministry and Kenan Akin, TRNC agriculture minister.
"Some 65,000 hectares, or 90 percent of the arable land of the TRNC, is completely hit by drought," Akin told reporters in Ankara.
"Agricultural cultivation will not be possible next year on that land," he said.
Turkish officials said the government would prepare a decree to enable the barley sale. They did not give details on the pricing of the barley.
